timing_methodology.recognition_seconds: Sum of each detect/confirm call and move placement; excludes video decode, rendering, encoding, app startup
timing_methodology.engine_wall_seconds: Engine-owned in-process timer around video processing; includes I/O and overlay
timing_methodology.elapsed_wall_seconds: External benchmark wall clock for each child process, includes interpreter / MATLAB startup
timing_methodology.external_overhead_seconds: elapsed_wall_seconds minus engine_wall_seconds; includes process startup, initialization, shutdown and final output, not startup alone
timing_methodology.playback_speed: Replay label only, not a computational speed setting

playback_validation: Mathematical replay endpoint model only; NOT a WPF GUI playback runtime test
note: Each selected playback speed repeats the 12 independent computational cases. Speed is metadata, NOT an engine acceleration setting; real GUI playback needs separate manual acceptance. Synthetic oracle is not real-world accuracy.
